NoAccess.title: You do not have access to this portal
NoAccess.text: Nazır is the portal of medrese and course staff. Your account holds no medrese or course role; the portal opens once you are given one.

Account.pageSubtitle: Your roles, permissions, time zone and language.
Account.tasksIntro: Every role applies in one scope. The person who assigned a role changes it and its term.
Account.noNazirNote: You hold no medrese nazır or course nazır role.
Account.permissionsIntro: Permissions come from your roles and from the permission groups given to you. You cannot give someone a permission that was given to you; the permissions that come from your role you can give within your own scope.
Account.permissionsEmpty: No permission comes from your roles and none has been given to you yet.

eachScope.MUDERRIS: Applies in each course you teach: {names}.
eachScope.default: Applies in each scope where you are {role}: {names}.

defaultsNote.KOSK_NAZIM: A köşk nazım’s default permissions. In the köşk’s medrese courses, opening the course and the müderris list belong to the medrese.
defaultsNote.MUDERRIS: A müderris’s default permissions. The course staff see the name and e-mail of the talebe enrolled in the course by default; this is not a separate permission.

permissions.kosk_manage: Edit the köşk, hide it or bring it back
permissions.kosk_hosting: Give or take back a hosting right
permissions.course_open_standalone: Open courses outside a medrese; choose the müderrisler and the imam
permissions.course_manage_all: Manage the content, sessions, recordings and applications of the courses in the köşk
permissions.ban_manage_kosk: Ban at course and köşk level, or lift a ban with a reason; widen a course ban to the köşk
permissions.deck_manage_kosk: Create and edit the köşk's deck
permissions.course_nazir_assign_kosk: Appoint a course nazır and grant permissions in the köşk's courses outside a medrese, within your own permissions
permissions.course_edit: Edit the course: title, introduction, syllabus, time zone
permissions.session_manage: Add a session, change its date, cancel it; enter the meeting link
permissions.session_live_link: Add the live-stream link to a session
permissions.week_hide: Hide a week or a session, bring it back
permissions.course_settings: Change the course settings and the closed-course flag
permissions.course_publish: Publish the course or return it to draft
permissions.course_view_unpublished: See a draft or hidden course
permissions.enrollment_remove: Remove a talebe from the course, with a reason
permissions.enrollment_complete: Mark a talebe as having completed the course
permissions.recording_manage: Add, rename and hide a recording; change its visibility
permissions.recording_watch_restricted: Watch recordings open to enrolled talebe only
permissions.session_view_content: See the content and meeting links of a session
permissions.ban_course: Ban a talebe from the course (includes seeing the course's ban list)
permissions.ban_lift_course: Lift a course ban, with a reason
permissions.deck_manage_course: Create and edit the course's deck
permissions.course_nazir_assign: Appoint a course nazır; grant a permission or a group, within your own permissions

permissionNotes.user_lookup: Every search is written to the audit log.
permissionNotes.ban_lift_course: You cannot lift a ban set by a higher level.

Settings.title: Medrese settings
Settings.subtitle: The medrese's name, its description and the policies that apply to all of its courses.
Settings.name: Medrese name
Settings.nameHelp: Talebe see this name on the medrese page and on the pages of its courses.

nameProblems.required: The medrese name cannot be empty.
nameProblems.short: The medrese name must be at least {min} characters.
nameProblems.long: The medrese name can be at most {max} characters.

Settings.descriptionHelp: Shown on the medrese page, above the list of courses.
Settings.descriptionLong: The description can be at most {max} characters.
Settings.policiesIntro: A policy closes a permission in all of the medrese's courses. A course's settings cannot open what a policy has closed.

closedCourseRequired.label: Closed course required
closedCourseRequired.help: When on, no content or recording of the medrese's courses can be opened to everyone; only a sample course chosen by the course staff may stay open in the introduction.

alwaysApproval.label: Enrolment always needs approval
alwaysApproval.help: When on, nobody can enrol in the medrese's courses directly; every enrolment becomes an application that the course staff approve.

noPublicRecordings.label: Recordings cannot be public
noPublicRecordings.help: When on, no recording can be made public or uploaded to YouTube; only enrolled talebe and the course staff watch the recordings.

Settings.policiesNote: A policy change takes effect the moment you save it and is written to the audit log.
Settings.narrowerTitle: A köşk's policy may be narrower
Settings.narrower: A medrese course also follows the policies of the köşk it is opened in; whichever is narrower applies.
Settings.saveFailedTitle: The settings could not be saved
Settings.saveFailedInvalid: Check the medrese name and the description and try again.
Settings.tiersIntro: A permission can be used only when it is on at all four levels; if one level closes it, it is closed.

medrese.help: Set by the head müderris or a medrese nazır with the permission

Dismiss.title: {name} is being dismissed
Dismiss.intro: {name} had given roles and permissions to these people. Choose what happens to each.
Dismiss.introNone: {name} has not given roles or permissions to anyone, so there is nothing to choose. Dismissing removes only their own role and permissions.
Dismiss.noPermissions: No permissions at all; a medrese nazır cannot give permissions to a nazır they appointed.
Dismiss.answersNote: If you take over, the role and permissions stay and you appear as the giver; if you drop, they are taken back at once. Every decision is written to the audit log.
Dismiss.gateNote: You cannot dismiss before choosing for every row.
